input.free_text_description: This system is a job/recommendation platform that serves Employer, Admin roles. The platform provides capabilities for activation panel, city, employer. Secondary concerns include file management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Employer, I want to receive notifications about important events, so that I can stay informed and respond promptly.
As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Employer, I want to browse job listings and receive personalized recommendations, so that I can find relevant career opportunities.
As a Employer, I want to upload and manage files, so that I can store and retrieve documents when needed.
As a Employer, I want to interact with activation panel functionality, so that I can accomplish my activation panel-related tasks.
